sources.population: IMF World Economic Outlook LP via DataMapper, Oct 2026 vintage (millions converted to persons; World Bank unavailable)
sources.fx_rate: No data available from World Bank or ECB

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection, one-line summaries
sport_note: One notable sporting event per year involving the country, editorial selection

geopolitical_news.headline: Militants pledge allegiance to al-Qaeda
geopolitical_news.summary: The Salafist Group for Preaching and Combat announces its merger with al-Qaeda in September, rebranding as AQIM.

geopolitical_news.headline: National reconciliation charter takes effect
geopolitical_news.summary: Amnesty measures for Islamist militants are implemented as the state declares the 1990s civil conflict over.

sport.headline: Algeria miss out on 2006 World Cup
sport.summary: The Desert Foxes finish well off the pace in qualifying, missing both the World Cup and the Africa Cup of Nations.

geopolitical_news.headline: Deadly bombings strike Algiers
geopolitical_news.summary: Twin December suicide bombings hit UN offices and the constitutional court, killing dozens in the capital.

geopolitical_news.headline: Ruling coalition wins legislative elections
geopolitical_news.summary: The FLN-led alliance takes May's parliamentary vote amid low turnout and opposition boycott calls.

sport.headline: Algeria fail to reach 2008 AFCON
sport.summary: The national team misses a second straight Africa Cup of Nations after a poor qualifying campaign.

geopolitical_news.headline: Constitution amended to allow third term
geopolitical_news.summary: Parliament removes presidential term limits in November, clearing Bouteflika to seek re-election in 2009.

geopolitical_news.headline: Suicide bombing hits police academy
geopolitical_news.summary: A deadly August attack in Issers kills dozens of recruits, one of AQIM's worst strikes that year.

sport.headline: Algeria top World Cup qualifying group
sport.summary: The Desert Foxes win their second-round group to stay in the hunt for a 2010 World Cup place.

geopolitical_news.headline: Bouteflika wins third term
geopolitical_news.summary: The president is re-elected in April amid opposition claims of fraud and low turnout.

geopolitical_news.headline: Football playoff sparks row with Egypt
geopolitical_news.summary: Violence around November's World Cup playoff in Khartoum triggers a diplomatic crisis between Algiers and Cairo.

sport.headline: Algeria beat Egypt to reach 2010 World Cup
sport.summary: A 1-0 playoff win over Egypt in Khartoum sends Algeria to its first World Cup in 24 years.

geopolitical_news.headline: Sporadic protests over prices and housing
geopolitical_news.summary: January demonstrations in Algiers foreshadow wider regional unrest, but are quickly contained by security forces.

geopolitical_news.headline: AQIM insurgency grinds on
geopolitical_news.summary: Militant attacks persist in the Kabylie region even as the government claims the upper hand.

sport.headline: Algeria reach AFCON semifinals
sport.summary: The Desert Foxes finish fourth at the 2010 Africa Cup of Nations, then hold England to a famous World Cup draw.

geopolitical_news.headline: Protests force end of emergency law
geopolitical_news.summary: Weeks of January demonstrations push the government to lift the 19-year state of emergency in February.

geopolitical_news.headline: Libya war strains Algiers
geopolitical_news.summary: Algeria shelters members of the Gaddafi family in August before recognizing Libya's new authorities in September.

sport.headline: Algeria miss 2012 AFCON
sport.summary: A shock qualifying failure keeps the Desert Foxes out of the 2012 Africa Cup of Nations.

geopolitical_news.headline: FLN wins legislative elections
geopolitical_news.summary: The ruling party takes May's parliamentary vote as the opposition alleges irregularities.

geopolitical_news.headline: Algeria mediates in Mali crisis
geopolitical_news.summary: Algiers hosts talks as northern Mali falls to Tuareg rebels and Islamist militants.

sport.headline: Algeria qualify for 2013 AFCON
sport.summary: A playoff win over Libya books Algeria's return to the Africa Cup of Nations.

geopolitical_news.headline: In Amenas gas plant siege
geopolitical_news.summary: Islamist militants seize a desert gas facility in January; the army assault leaves dozens of hostages dead.

geopolitical_news.headline: Bouteflika hospitalized in Paris
geopolitical_news.summary: The president suffers a stroke in April, fueling speculation about his fitness to govern.

sport.headline: Algeria exit AFCON at group stage
sport.summary: Three defeats in South Africa send the Desert Foxes home early from the 2013 tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Bouteflika wins fourth term
geopolitical_news.summary: The ailing president is re-elected in April despite rarely appearing in public during the campaign.

geopolitical_news.headline: Air Algerie plane crashes in Mali
geopolitical_news.summary: Flight AH5017 goes down in July en route from Ouagadougou to Algiers, killing all 116 on board.

sport.headline: Algeria reach World Cup last 16
sport.summary: Wins over South Korea and a draw with Russia take Algeria to the knockout stage, where Germany win in extra time.

geopolitical_news.headline: Algeria brokers Mali peace deal
geopolitical_news.summary: The Algiers Accord signed in June aims to end northern Mali's rebellion, with Algeria as guarantor.

geopolitical_news.headline: Oil price crash squeezes economy
geopolitical_news.summary: Plunging crude revenues force subsidy cuts and austerity in the hydrocarbon-dependent state.

sport.headline: Algeria fall in AFCON quarterfinals
sport.summary: A 3-1 defeat to eventual champions Ivory Coast ends Algeria's 2015 campaign in Equatorial Guinea.

geopolitical_news.headline: Constitutional reform adopted
geopolitical_news.summary: February amendments restore term limits and make Tamazight an official language.

geopolitical_news.headline: Succession questions grow
geopolitical_news.summary: Bouteflika's prolonged absences from public life deepen uncertainty over who really governs Algeria.

sport.headline: Algeria qualify for 2017 AFCON
sport.summary: The Desert Foxes top their qualifying group to book a place at the Gabon tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Ruling parties win legislative vote
geopolitical_news.summary: The FLN and RND take May's parliamentary elections amid record-low turnout.

geopolitical_news.headline: Algeria-Morocco border stays shut
geopolitical_news.summary: Rabat-Algiers ties remain frozen over Western Sahara as the land border stays closed.

sport.headline: Algeria exit AFCON in group stage
sport.summary: Defeats to Tunisia and Senegal condemn Algeria to an early exit in Gabon.

geopolitical_news.headline: Military plane crash kills 257
geopolitical_news.summary: An April crash near Boufarik becomes Algeria's deadliest aviation disaster.

geopolitical_news.headline: Cocaine seizure scandal rocks elite
geopolitical_news.summary: A massive May drug bust at Oran port exposes corruption links reaching into the ruling circle.

sport.headline: Algeria miss 2018 World Cup
sport.summary: A dismal qualifying campaign ends with Algeria bottom of their group.

geopolitical_news.headline: Hirak protests force Bouteflika out
geopolitical_news.summary: Mass weekly demonstrations beginning in February compel the president to resign on April 2.

geopolitical_news.headline: Tebboune elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: Abdelmadjid Tebboune wins December's election, which the protest movement boycotts.

geopolitical_news.headline: Army chief Gaid Salah dies
geopolitical_news.summary: The powerful military chief who managed the transition dies of a heart attack in December.

sport.headline: Algeria win Africa Cup of Nations
sport.summary: Mahrez's stoppage-time winner against Nigeria and a 1-0 final victory over Senegal deliver the title.

geopolitical_news.headline: Hirak suspended by pandemic
geopolitical_news.summary: Weekly protests halt in March as COVID-19 arrives; authorities jail protest figures during the pause.

geopolitical_news.headline: Constitutional referendum passes
geopolitical_news.summary: November's vote on Tebboune's reforms passes amid very low turnout and a boycott.

sport.headline: Football shut down by pandemic
sport.summary: Domestic and international fixtures are suspended for months as Algeria battles COVID-19.

geopolitical_news.headline: Algeria severs ties with Morocco
geopolitical_news.summary: Algiers cuts diplomatic relations in August, accusing Rabat of hostile acts over Western Sahara.

geopolitical_news.headline: Deadly wildfires ravage Kabylie
geopolitical_news.summary: August blazes kill dozens and displace thousands in the worst wildfires in Algeria's history.

sport.headline: Algeria's 35-match unbeaten run ends
sport.summary: A record unbeaten streak stretching back to 2018 is snapped by Equatorial Guinea at the Africa Cup of Nations.

geopolitical_news.headline: Algeria hosts Arab League summit
geopolitical_news.summary: November's summit in Algiers is dominated by food security and the Palestinian question.

geopolitical_news.headline: Algeria freezes treaty with Spain
geopolitical_news.summary: Algiers suspends its friendship treaty with Madrid in June after Spain backs Morocco on Western Sahara.

sport.headline: Algeria lose World Cup playoff to Cameroon
sport.summary: A stoppage-time away-goals defeat in Blida denies Algeria a place at Qatar 2022.

geopolitical_news.headline: BRICS rejects Algeria's membership bid
geopolitical_news.summary: Algiers' application to join the bloc fails at the August summit despite lobbying.

geopolitical_news.headline: Tebboune reshuffles government
geopolitical_news.summary: Cabinet changes aim to revive the economy as the president eyes a second term.

sport.headline: Algeria qualify for 2023 AFCON
sport.summary: The Desert Foxes top their qualifying group to reach the Ivory Coast tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Tebboune re-elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: The incumbent wins September's vote, though turnout figures spark opposition skepticism.

geopolitical_news.headline: Algeria joins UN Security Council
geopolitical_news.summary: Algiers takes a non-permanent seat in January, championing Palestinian statehood.

sport.headline: Algeria crash out of AFCON group stage
sport.summary: A humiliating defeat to Mauritania seals a winless group-stage exit in Ivory Coast.

geopolitical_news.headline: Algeria-France diplomatic crisis deepens
geopolitical_news.summary: The detention of writer Boualem Sansal and disputes over Western Sahara freeze ties with Paris.

geopolitical_news.headline: Algeria downs Malian drone, sparking row
geopolitical_news.summary: An April border incident prompts Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger to recall their ambassadors.

sport.headline: Algeria qualify for 2026 World Cup
sport.summary: An October win over Somalia seals Algeria's return to the World Cup after a 12-year absence.
